notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
I realized Current version of game has a little bug, one of pickable items is floating. I fixed that.

Note:you cannot interact with CV in the living room. this is not a bug.

notes.title: Reflection of sin Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone Reflection of sin "The Big Update" is here. 
What's new?

-New Ambiance sounds
-Ambiance Music
-Renewed Events
-New Events
-5 New Loop
-3 New Creatures
- New Puzzles

I have been working on this update for 3 or 4 days and when I saw some criticism I thought I should improve my game. I added new events to the game, I added 3 new creatures, I brought new events and renewed events.
